reviewer_role: Project owner manual rubric review, AI-assisted

decisions.rationale: The cited Timure draft explicitly requests immediate human access verification before any routing or clearance decision.
The cited Bidur draft explicitly requests immediate location-specific residential-impact triage using the saved CEMS impact facts.
The cited Syapru Besi draft requests a power-plant and school continuity check within six hours and remains a human-reviewable draft.
The limitation preserves Bharatpur as waiting for data, but no proposed action requests product delivery. The evaluation contract requires a concrete proposal action for coverage.
